daily.title: ITAT Quashes Reassessment for Vague Section 148 Notice and Absence of Valid Satisfaction
daily.summary: Delhi ITAT quashes reassessment following Galaxy Group search due to a vague Section 148 notice and absence of valid satisfaction linking seized material. The participating institutions also state that the exercise showed existing securities can move between traditional and DLT-based licensed market infrastructures.
